title: Adopt CoordinateCleaner/bdc spatial-flag taxonomy as @csp/validate vocabulary and port golden fixtures
context: PLAN v0.2 explicitly adopts the CoordinateCleaner/bdc validated spatial-flag taxonomy (sea / zero / centroid / capital / institution / urban / outlier, validated against ~91M GBIF records) as the vocabulary for @csp/validate's spatial axis, rather than inventing novel spatial heuristics. The engine orchestrates and standardizes these validated flags. M1 exit criteria require CoordinateCleaner/bdc test cases to be ported as golden fixtures in CI. csp-validate-005 covers general spatial validation but does not mention or adopt this taxonomy, leaving the spatial-flag vocabulary undefined. Depends on csp-validate-005.
objective: Extend @csp/validate's spatial validators to use the CoordinateCleaner/bdc flag taxonomy (sea, zero-coordinate, centroid, capital, institution, urban, outlier) as the official flag vocabulary, document the mapping from each flag to its remediation guidance, and port representative CoordinateCleaner/bdc test cases as golden fixtures in CI.
acceptanceCriteria: Spatial ValidationReport flags use the CoordinateCleaner/bdc taxonomy (sea / zero / centroid / capital / institution / urban / outlier) as their vocabulary; no novel spatial flag names invented that duplicate this taxonomy
Representative CoordinateCleaner/bdc test cases (covering each major flag type) ported as golden fixtures; these pass in CI against the TypeScript implementation
Documentation explains the provenance and definition of each flag type, referencing CoordinateCleaner/bdc as the source
Spatial validators remain pure and side-effect-free, conforming to the existing @csp/validate ValidationReport contract
output: A PR extending @csp/validate's spatial validators to use the CoordinateCleaner/bdc flag taxonomy and adding golden fixture tests derived from CoordinateCleaner/bdc test cases.
